snippet.title: System Shock Remake - Coming Soon to Nintendo Switch and Switch 2 | Nightdive Studios
snippet.description:
The critically acclaimed System Shock remake is COMING SOON to Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2 with Joy-Con 2 mouse support, gyro aiming, and added features inspired by community feedback!
===================================
System Shock
— Available Now on PC, Xbox, and PlayStation —
===================================
🔴 Nintendo Switch: https://bit.ly/SystemShockSwitch
🔴 Nintendo Switch 2: https://bit.ly/SystemShockSwitch2 

🟡 Steam: https://bit.ly/SystemShock-Steam
🟣 GOG: https://bit.ly/SystemShockGOG

🟠 Humble: https://bit.ly/SystemShockHumble
🟢 Xbox: https://bit.ly/SystemShockXbox
